Only ryo.co (audioguide app, article names Bengal figs but no specific tree or garden; contact https://ryo.co/es/contacto) and hoteles.net (booking portal, kept above). Rest are the Ayuntamiento/FEMAS PDFs and esdiario.

Searches in English and Dutch return only the Bomenstichting walking booklet (2021 PDF), boomzorg.nl top-ten PDF, NH Nieuws (news) and Hortus travel pages. No independent blog on monumental trees found. bonjouramsterdam.fr and amsterdamtips.com surfaced for the Hortus but were not fetched.

Beyond ftrc.blog the hits are berlin.de, visitberlin.de, berlinstadtservice.de, Tagesspiegel (newspaper), komoot blog and berlinexperiences.com (not fetched). Harald Vieth's book on Berlin and Potsdam notable trees exists but no site.

No independent blog found. Hits: barcelona.cat catalogue of Trees of Local Interest, beteve.cat (TV), Time Out Spain, meer.com, femturisme.cat (Catalonia generally). barcelonaurbana.com (parks list) names only an unnamed oak at Jardins de la Tamarita, no match with our trees. Hits are edinburgh.org (tourist board), RBGE, Scotsman, ancient-yew.org, undiscoveredscotland.co.uk and cyclingscot blog (Dawyck, outside the city). No independent Edinburgh old-tree blog found. The Scotsman covers the Colinton Manse yew.
